THE CHALLENGE

A lease up that changed hands halfway through.

A new owner means a new story, but renters do not wait for a rebrand. Huxley had to keep leasing in a competitive North Scottsdale luxury market while everything about how it showed up online changed hands.

We took over social, Google and the community's online presence and made it one story from day one of the new ownership.
